answer: Truffle hunter licence with woodland search logs is the check: searches logged in one wood across seasons. A farm faking 158 aliases needs 158 separate search logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Call it the pigment rule: fakes pay per head, the honest pay once, the falcon record is open for audit, and the saffron window is too short for 158 aliases to earn their price back.
